examples.scenario: A ransomware attack targeting an enterprise file server where attackers first exfiltrate sensitive data via encrypted outbound HTTPS connections before encrypting local files and dropping ransom notes.

examples.detection_method: Network monitoring systems detect unusual large HTTPS POST requests to unknown external domains with anomalous TLS certificates. Endpoint detection identifies suspicious PowerShell execution downloading DLL payloads and rundll32.exe executing unknown DLLs from temp directories. File integrity monitoring triggers alerts on mass encryption of files with .encrypted extensions and creation of ransom note text files. DNS logs reveal queries to suspicious C2 domains. Correlation of these logs and artifacts triggers ransomware data exfiltration and encryption detection workflow.
